title: Common Fractions: Adding, Subtracting and Mixed Numbers
seo_title: Grade 7 Common Fractions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Add and subtract common fractions, including mixed numbers; find fractions of whole numbers; convert mixed numbers to common fractions in order to perform calculations with them; use knowledge of multiples and factors to write fractions in the simplest form before or after calculations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 fractions worksheets: adding and subtracting fractions with same, related and different denominators and mixed numbers. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To add or subtract fractions, give them a common denominator (use the LCM).
  • 23 + 34 = 812 + 912 = 1712 = 1 512.
  • For mixed numbers, add the wholes and the fractions, then regroup.
  • Write the answer in simplest form.

Examples

Example

3 14 − 1 23

2 1512 − 1 812

Answer: 1 712

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding denominatorsKeep the common denominator.
Changing the bottom onlyMultiply the top too.
Not regroupingBorrow a whole when the fraction is too small.

items.q: Ofentse ate 13 of a pizza and Kabelo ate 14. What fraction of the pizza did they eat altogether?
